claude-code.notes: Skills live as directories (Claude Code reads frontmatter from SKILL.md). Agents are flat files at .claude/agents/<name>.md with frontmatter — we extract the inner agent.md. Hook scripts are stored under .claude/hooks/<name>.sh but must also be referenced from .claude/settings.json to actually run. Rules land at .claude/rules/<name>.md — Claude Code does not auto-load this directory; reference the rules from CLAUDE.md or another loaded context file.

cursor.notes: Cursor's only persistent customization is project rules at .cursor/rules/<name>.mdc. Each rule's frontmatter is generated to match Cursor's contract (description, globs, alwaysApply). Override per-asset by adding overrides.cursor.{globs, alwaysApply} to the source frontmatter.

antigravity.notes: Google Antigravity reads skills as directories containing SKILL.md. Workspace location is .agent/skills/; global at ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/. The assetPaths.skills value is empty so skills land at the target root.

gemini-cli.notes: Gemini CLI's skills support is evolving. This config places skills at ~/.gemini/skills/ (global) or .gemini/skills/ (workspace). Verify against your installed Gemini CLI version — earlier versions only honour a GEMINI.md context file.

vscode-copilot.notes: Generates VS Code Copilot's expected frontmatter on the destination: applyTo for instructions, mode for prompts, description for chat modes. Per-asset overrides via overrides.vscode-copilot.{applyTo,mode,tools,model}. For Copilot to load the files, enable the workspace setting chat.promptFiles.

copilot-cli.notes: Shares destination conventions with vscode-copilot. The newer agentic Copilot CLI (the `copilot` command) reads .github/copilot-instructions.md plus .github/instructions/ and .github/prompts/. Global ~/.copilot/ holds user-wide instructions. The legacy `gh copilot` extension does NOT consume these files.

kiro.notes: AWS Kiro reads markdown files from .kiro/steering/ to inject project-wide guidance into the agent. Hooks at .kiro/hooks/ also need a corresponding .kiro.hook JSON metadata file; this config installs the script only, you must register it via the Kiro UI or by hand-crafting the .kiro.hook file.

kiro-cli.notes: Treated as a sibling of Kiro IDE — shares .kiro/steering/ at workspace scope and supports a ~/.kiro/ user-wide steering directory. If your Kiro CLI build uses different paths, override this config or pass --target.
